children: Romania's consolidated budget showed a deficit of 2.89% of GDP at the end of August, the Finance Ministry said on Saturday, compared with a 4.51% shortfall in the same period of 2025.
In nominal terms, the deficit was 59.42 billion lei ($12.84 billion). Romania is targeting a deficit of 6.2% this year.
